payload.title: Finish the Kev adapter with versioned endpoint behavior
payload.description:
## Scope

Verify the actual Kev System One endpoint contract against the conventions used in Biased-Decisions. Add injected transport, model/version identity, timeout/error handling, and documented optional installation.

## Definition of done

Network-free fixture specs cover choices, structured context, malformed replies, and endpoint errors; no missing usage or model metadata is invented.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Finish the Kev adapter with versioned endpoint behavior
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a scripted Kev endpoint returns a labeled choice and model metadata
    When the adapter normalizes the reply
    Then the decision retains the correct label, available probabilities, and model version
```
